facts.business: POCL Enterprises Limited (POEL) is engaged in metal manufacturing, including lead metal, zinc metal, and PVC additives, with operations in domestic and international markets.

auditor.name: CNGSN & Associates LLP
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: No qualifications, reservations or adverse remarks in Standalone and Consolidated Auditor's Report for FY 2025-26. Auditor resigned effective August 14, 2026; R K C G & Associates LLP appointed as new Statutory Auditors.

key_risks: Commodity price volatility (lead, zinc, other metals)
Currency fluctuations due to import/export operations
Commodity inflation impacting production costs and margins
Increasing competition from organized and unorganized players
Pandemic-related supply chain and demand deterioration
